notes.text: I-Blitz Split manje isikhuluma isiDashi, isiJaphani, isiThekhi nesi-Indonesia, futhi uhlu lwezilimi lubiza ulimi ngalunye ngolimi lwalo.
Amaqembu nezindleko manje angasebenzisa i-zloty yasePoland, i-lira yaseTurkey ne-rupiah yase-Indonesia.
I-Iphrofayela inenkinobho entsha, Yabelana ngephrofayela: noma ubani ovula ilinki yakho ubona igama lakho nesithombe futhi angakumema eqenjini.
Ilinki yesimemo yeqembu elisha ilungile ngokushesha, ngisho ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, futhi i-Amalungu inenkinobho entsha yokuyikopisha.
Ukuvala ifomu elinokuthile ongakakulondolozi manje kuqala kubuze ukuthi "Lahla izinguquko?".
I-Inqubomgomo yobumfihlo ne-Imigomo yesevisi manje kuvuleka ngaphakathi ku-app esikhundleni sesiphequluli.
Efonini, amabha angenhla nangezansi manje ayasuka endleleni lapho uskrola uya phansi futhi abuye lapho uskrola uya phezulu.
Ku-Hlukanisa isindleko, ukukhetha usuku akusagxumeli ngqo ewashini: isikhathi sinenkinobho yaso.
Thepha iqembu phezulu ku-Hlukanisa isindleko ukuze ulivule; ukubuyela emuva kubuyela esindlekweni nakho konke obukuthayiphile.
I-Izindleko zakamuva ze-Ikhaya manje zibonisa iqembu lesindleko ngasinye nokuthi ubani okhokhile njengezithombe.
I-Pix manje ivela kuphela kubantu okungenzeka bayisebenzise, njengalabo abasebenzisa i-app ngesiPutukezi, abanokhiye we-Pix noma abaseqenjini elisebenzisa i-real.
Ukuthi "Kuyavumelaniswa…" manje kuvela kuphela okokuqala lapho i-akhawunti yakho ilayisha kudivayisi, hhayi ngaso sonke isikhathi sokuvumelanisa.
I-Iphrofayela ayisanikezi ukunqamula i-Google noma i-Apple ku-akhawunti yakho: phuma ngemvume noma usule i-akhawunti esikhundleni salokho.
Ukuthi Hlela iphrofayela manje kuvuleka njengeshidi phezu kwe-Iphrofayela esikhundleni sesikrini esihlukile.
Ibhande elingenalutho phakathi kwefomu nekhibhodi ku-Hlukanisa isindleko alisekho.
Ukuthi Amaqembu enihlanganyela kuwo komuntu oxhumana naye manje kubonisa isithombe seqembu ngalinye.
